name: get_equipment_status
description: Get real-time equipment health status with live sensor readings (temperature, vibration, RPM, oil pressure, power), a computed health score (0-100), operating state, and ISO 10816-based alert flags.

equipment_id.description: Equipment identifier (e.g., 'EQ-CNC-001', 'EQ-PUMP-014'). Prefix determines type: CNC, PUMP, COMP, CONV, TURB, MOTOR

name: get_equipment_list
description: List all equipment in a facility with status summary: per-machine health score, criticality, last/next maintenance dates, facility-wide status counts, and critical machines below health threshold.

name: get_sensor_data
description: Get historical sensor time-series data for an equipment with statistics (mean, min, max, std dev), trend direction, and warning/critical threshold breach counts.

sensor_type.description: Sensor type (One of: temperature, vibration, rpm, oil_pressure, power)

hours.description: Number of hours of history to retrieve (1-720) (Default: 24)

name: get_equipment_alerts
description: Get all active alerts across all equipment in the facility, prioritized by severity (CRITICAL/WARNING/INFO), with recommended actions and acknowledgment status.
